name: trace-browser-extension
description: Trace browser and Safari Web Extension source

scripts.build:legacy: npm run build:core && TRACE_SESSION_MODE=legacy node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:legacy:release: npm run build:core && TRACE_BUILD_MODE=release TRACE_SESSION_MODE=legacy node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:kernel: npm run build:core && TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:kernel:release: npm run build:core && TRACE_BUILD_MODE=release TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:ios-active-tab-probe: npm run build:core && TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel TRACE_IOS_ACTIVE_TAB_PROBE=1 node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:ios-active-tab-probe:release: npm run build:core && TRACE_BUILD_MODE=release TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel TRACE_IOS_ACTIVE_TAB_PROBE=1 node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:ios-active-tab-optional-hosts-prob: npm run build:core && TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel TRACE_IOS_ACTIVE_TAB_OPTIONAL_HOSTS_PROBE=1 node scripts/build.mjs
npm run build:core && TRACE_BUILD_MODE=release TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel TRACE_IOS_ACTIVE_TAB_OPTIONAL_HOSTS_PROBE=1 node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:ios-earned-permission-onboarding: npm run build:core && TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel TRACE_IOS_EARNED_PERMISSION_ONBOARDING=1 node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:ios-earned-permission-onboarding:r: npm run build:core && TRACE_BUILD_MODE=release TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel TRACE_IOS_EARNED_PERMISSION_ONBOARDING=1 TRACE_API_BASE=https://api.tracefiction.com TRACE_WEB_ORIGIN=https://www.tracefiction.com node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:ios-earned-permission-onboarding:p: npm run build:core && TRACE_BUILD_MODE=release TRACE_SESSION_MODE=kernel TRACE_IOS_EARNED_PERMISSION_ONBOARDING=1 TRACE_IOS_EARNED_PERMISSION_PREVIEW_RELEASE=1 node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:disabled: npm run build:core && TRACE_SESSION_MODE=disabled node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:disabled:release: npm run build:core && TRACE_BUILD_MODE=release TRACE_SESSION_MODE=disabled node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:release && npm run zip:chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:release && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:session:packages && npm run test:native-import-package && node --test test/collector.test.js test/end-of-story.test.js test/library-overlay.test.js test/library-overlay-runtime.test.js test/library-overlay-site-hint.test.js test/background-runtime.test.js test/build-origin-permissions.test.mjs test/popup.test.js test/sync.test.js test/ao3-saved-filters.test.js test/prepare-store-screenshots.test.js
scripts.agent:check: npm run agent:lint && npm run test:swift-provider-codec && npm run test:swift-import-inbox && npm test && npm run build:release && npm run agent:lint
